guarantees.claim: prng_reseed_done_q is asynchronously reset to 1'b0 when rst_ni is low; otherwise, on every rising edge of clk_i, it is updated to the value of prng_reseed_done_d.

assumptions.claim: prng_reseed_done_d must correctly reflect whether PRNG reseeding is complete and be stable around the active clock edge.
assumptions.risk: If prng_reseed_done_d has an incorrect or glitchy value, the registered prng_reseed_done_q may cause the FSM to believe reseeding is done prematurely or not at all, potentially allowing AES operation with weak entropy.

uncertain_points.claim: The register captures prng_reseed_done_d every clock cycle. If prng_reseed_done_d is a pulse shorter than one clock period, it may be missed, leading to a deadlock where PRNG reseed is complete but never acknowledged.
uncertain_points.risk: The AES FSM could wait indefinitely for reseed, locking up the crypto core.
